stack_spec.name: Spec4
stack_spec.description: A locally-served, developer-facing pipeline app (Dash + Dash Mantine Components) that turns a rough idea or existing codebase into a versioned folder of specs. This revision completes the dev-tool register rollout across the five remaining screens (directory picker, project-mode question, setup wizard, gate card, Designer wizard), reorders the project view so agent rows lead, and adds an explicit per-agent reasoning-effort control alongside the existing per-agent model control — using only the Python standard library, litellm, and existing DMC/Dash primitives, with no new dependency of any kind.

languages.name: Python
languages.role: Dash application server, callbacks, and UI layout composition (backend and server-rendered UI are one deployable)
languages.trailing_commas: in multi-line collections and function calls

languages.name: CSS
languages.role: shell, theme, and project-view spacing/density styling; hand-authored, no preprocessor, no new build tooling
languages.quotes: double (for consistency with the rest of the codebase)

naming_conventions.files: snake_case (v3.css retained as the single stylesheet)

targets.name: spec4_app
targets.purpose: the single local Dash application: serves the UI (status bar, project view with agent rows leading, round tree, round cost, chat frame, Artifact View, directory picker, project-mode question, setup wizard, gate card, Designer wizard) and runs the pipeline-agent backend in one process
targets.runtime: Python 3.12, served via gunicorn (production-style local serving) or the Dash dev server (DASH_DEBUG=true)
targets.hosting: local machine only, at localhost:8050; no cloud hosting, no multi-tenant deployment
targets.distribution: run locally via the `spec4` CLI entrypoint, `uv run python src/spec4/app.py`, or gunicorn per the existing Makefile `deploy` target

exposure.transport: HTTP on localhost only; not exposed beyond the local machine

libraries.name: Dash
libraries.purpose: core web application framework serving both the UI and its server-side callbacks; this round's five reworked screens (directory picker, project-mode question, setup wizard, gate card, Designer wizard) and the reordered project view continue to use dcc.Location for routing and dcc.Store/State for reading the shared session and prefs stores; no new Dash capability is introduced

libraries.name: Dash Mantine Components
libraries.purpose: the sole UI component layer; this round's remaining register reworks (single-column monospace directory list, folded folder-creation row, two-button mode question, terse setup wizard with dimmed helper lines, one-line gate panel, plain-text Designer stepper) and the new per-agent Effort select are built entirely from existing DMC primitives (dmc.Text, dmc.Select, dmc.TextInput, dmc.Button, dmc.Group/Stack) — no new component or dependency is introduced; the accent remains the single Mantine theme primary throughout

libraries.name: dash-iconify
libraries.purpose: icon components used in place of the removed emoji throughout the shell and rows; unchanged this round

libraries.name: litellm
libraries.purpose: multi-provider LLM gateway used by the seven pipeline agents; this round it also backs Per-Agent Effort end to end — litellm.get_supported_openai_params is reused (no new probing path) to determine only whether 'reasoning_effort' is accepted for the resolved model (not which levels); 'low'/'medium'/'high' are offered when accepted, 'xhigh'/'max' only per a small provider-keyed table in llm_selection.py; drop_params=True continues to silently drop the parameter entirely when unsupported; when the parameter is accepted but a specific level is rejected, the existing retry path retries once with no effort and the call is recorded as 'default (fallback from <value>)'

libraries.name: mcp
libraries.purpose: Model Context Protocol client SDK used elsewhere in the pipeline; unchanged this round

libraries.name: boto3
libraries.purpose: AWS SDK supporting litellm's optional Bedrock/SageMaker routing; unchanged this round

libraries.name: httpx
libraries.purpose: general HTTP client used across the app; unchanged this round

libraries.name: jsonschema
libraries.purpose: validates artifact JSON files against their schemas; unchanged this round

libraries.name: gunicorn
libraries.purpose: production-style WSGI server for local deployment; unchanged this round

libraries.name: pyyaml
libraries.purpose: YAML parsing used elsewhere in the pipeline; unchanged this round

libraries.name: mypy
libraries.purpose: strict static type checking across the codebase; unchanged this round

libraries.name: types-pyyaml
libraries.purpose: type stubs for pyyaml, required for mypy strict mode; unchanged this round

libraries.name: pytest
libraries.purpose: test runner (uv run pytest) for the existing suite (agents, layouts, callbacks, session, project-manager) plus this round's verification of the five reworked screens, the reordered project view, and per-agent effort resolution/storage; verification for this round is pytest-only, against layout functions and callbacks

libraries.name: pytest-cov
libraries.purpose: coverage measurement for the pytest suite; unchanged this round

libraries.name: Playwright
libraries.purpose: browser automation used only by scripts/screenshot_ui.py to capture UI screenshots during development; it is not part of this round's (or any round's) test verification, which is pytest-only

libraries.name: Ruff
libraries.purpose: linting (and formatting via ruff format) for all Python source; unchanged this round

artifact_store.choice: local filesystem JSON files under .spec4/v{N}/, one file per artifact, produced by the pipeline agents
artifact_store.purpose: source of truth for every Artifact and UsageRecord the app's screens read; unchanged this round — Artifact View and its file-resolution logic are carried forward without modification
artifact_store.durability: source of truth for artifact content; survives restarts and is unaffected by browser state

collections.name: round_artifacts
physical: one file per artifact under .spec4/v{N}/, path fixed by pipeline order; status derived live from the existing dependency graph (mtime comparison against upstream artifacts); unchanged this round

collections.name: usage_records
collections.purpose: per-round usage/cost rollup; deliberately excluded from the artifact dependency graph and never marked needs-update; now also the durable record of which reasoning effort was actually used per call, including fallback-from-rejected-value outcomes
physical: usage.json, one per round, per-agent model/tokens/cost totals; each call's record now also carries an effort field, holding either the effort actually used or 'default (fallback from <value>)' when a rejected effort value triggered the no-effort retry

browser_store.choice: existing browser dcc.Store pair — sessionStorage (session) and localStorage (prefs); no server-side session
browser_store.purpose: remembers the working directory, project mode, and default/per-agent provider, model, and effort across navigations and, for prefs, across browser sessions on the same machine, without any state touching the server or disk
browser_store.durability: session store is cleared when the tab closes (not durable); prefs store persists on-device across sessions but is not backed up or synced

collections.name: session_store
physical: sessionStorage, read via callback State; now also holds each agent's chosen model+effort for the current round (GateSelection) and the once-per-session ProjectMode answer

collections.name: prefs_store
physical: localStorage, read via callback State; BYOK provider keys live here client-side only and never reach the server or disk; now also holds the project's default effort alongside the default provider/model

patterns: Dash Mantine Components remains the sole UI/component layer; no React, Tailwind, or other new front-end dependency is introduced
layout helpers in layouts/_shared.py (e.g. _card, cost_summary_card) are reused rather than duplicated, including by the Artifact View's content-pane header
agent pipeline order is defined once in app_constants.AGENT_KEYS; all agent-ordered tables (round tree, agent rows, chat frame pill bar) are derived from or asserted against it
status (artifact presence/staleness, agent action, cost) is recomputed from the existing dependency graph and usage.json on every render, never cached
existing component ids are kept as a test contract, except the removed Back buttons, whose tests are updated
the accent color is set once as the Mantine theme primary; components inherit it rather than setting color locally

the active/complete/dimmed marking used by the chat frame's pill bar (layouts/_chat.py) is factored into one shared renderer in layouts/_shared.py and reused as-is by the setup wizard's step indicator and the Designer wizard's step row — never reimplemented per screen
per-agent model and effort resolution share one read/write path in llm_selection.py, used identically by the gate card, model chip, retry panel, and setup wizard
documentation: design decisions recorded as numbered comments (D-XX) at the point of implementation, per existing convention

project_structure.purpose: project view (agent rows first, round cost second, round tree third, per this round's reorder), directory picker, and project-mode question; the picker and question this round adopt the dev-tool register (monospace single-column directory list, folded folder-creation row, two-line/two-button mode question) with behavior unchanged

three-step setup wizard (SETUP_IDS), shared with the per-agent gate (GATE_IDS); this round trims prose to single dimmed lines, removes the free-tier alert and the directory-picker return button, and adds the per-agent/default Effort select beside the model select

per-agent model gate, reworked this round into a one-line monospace naming panel (agent + default model) with a two-/three-button row; inherits the Effort select when 'Pick a model' expands; the separate 'Designer' heading above the gate on the Designer route is removed

Designer wizard; this round replaces its circular/checked stepper with the shared plain-text stepper renderer from _shared.py, trims intro/help text and upload-zone copy to single dimmed lines, and removes glyphs from step buttons; steps, fields, and preview/cost/retry behavior are unchanged
the Artifact View screen; unchanged this round — carried forward as-is, including its file-resolution logic
chat frame layout; unchanged this round — its plain-text pill bar renderer is the source extracted into layouts/_shared.py for reuse by the setup wizard and Designer wizard steppers

reusable layout helpers (cards, cost summary, round tree, and — new this round — the shared active/complete/dimmed stepper/pill-bar renderer extracted from _chat.py) shared across the project view, chat frame, Artifact View, setup wizard, and Designer wizard

Dash server-side callbacks; this round adds/updates callbacks for the reordered project view, the five reworked screens, and reading/writing the per-agent and default Effort value through the single llm_selection.py path
single stylesheet; this round's picker/question/setup/gate/Designer register styling (dashed upload outlines, single-column monospace lists, dimmed helper lines) lands here
existing artifact dependency graph, staleness detection, and agent button state; unchanged this round
session defaults and artifact persistence; source of working-directory, round, and project-mode state

per-agent model AND effort resolution shared by the gate card, model chip, retry panel, and setup wizard; extended this round with a provider-keyed table of which providers accept 'xhigh'/'max' effort values, used alongside litellm's own accept/reject probe for 'reasoning_effort'; single read/write path for the stored (model, effort) pair
single source of the seven-agent pipeline order (AGENT_KEYS), used by the round tree, agent rows, and the chat frame's pill bar
pytest suite mirroring src/ layout; extended this round with tests for the reordered project view, the five reworked screens, and per-agent effort resolution/storage/fallback
